name: Snow Way Out
sources: LP1 3:07:14-3:13:44 (archive.org PS4 longplay Part 1; frames every 2 s at 854x480, 0.5 s in the bonus; HUD crops; exit crate sign)
gamepressure.com Snow Way Out walkthrough (enemy/hazard corroboration only)
camera: mixed: into-screen harbour paths and floe fields; side view for the timed-! climbs, the bonus, icefalls and the waterfall gorge
typesNote: Crash 4 keys: wood, question, arrowWood (wooden arrow crate), reinforced (metal-banded X-frame 'strong crate', body slam or blast), tnt, nitro (counted; any left standing are paid by the exit Nitro switch), timedOutline (pink outline crate made solid for a few seconds by a red timed ! box; counted when broken), goldFruit (gold crate with a wumpa emblem, one hit, large fruit payout), fire ('inferno' crate that jets flame on a cycle), checkpoint (counted), unknown. Red timed ! boxes, iron blocks and the green Nitro switch are not counted.

routes.basis: 153 minus bonus 33; includes 2 Nitro paid by the exit switch

sections.notes: GR 17; HUD 0 (LP1 3:07:16) and 2 (3:07:18). Three timed red-! groups taught under slow-mo.
GR 35; LP transfer 57 + 11 -> 68 after the bonus confirms 35 before it. Crossbow longshoremen, boats, TNT, one strong crate.
HUD 0/33 (LP1 3:08:22) -> 33/33; main 68/153 at 3:09:06. Side view; two Nitro lids and three red-! groups.
GR 74. Narrow wall-top boardwalk along the ice canyon; cutscene at LP1 3:09:26.
GR 75 (tower, easy to miss) and 79 (C2 with the crates before the falling ice).
GR 85. Falling ice slabs (slow-mo), lit dock, flame-jetting crate pyramid; Flashback tape at LP1 3:10:00.
GR 86/92/97/104/105. Floe crate toward camera, hidden-gem springboard stack, boat, arrow to two high crates, waterfall room.
HUD 116/153 at LP1 3:11:36 (just after C4). GR says 108 here; GR's next figure (122 at C5) is consistent with 116 + 6.
GR 122. Falling ice blocks on a narrow ledge; TNT under a higher crate.
GR 124/125/137; HUD 133/153 at LP1 3:12:54 (on the motorboat, before the exit pier's 4).
GR 141/151/153. Exit crate sign reads 147/153 (LP1 3:13:24-26) then 151/153 (3:13:28); the Nitro switch pays 2.

puzzles.summary: Red timed ! groups: pink outline crates become solid for a few seconds; three teaching instances in S1, then a staircase in S7 whose top holds a permanent crate.
puzzles.solution: Hit the !, switch slow-mo on, and take the crates in path order; in S7 climb the materialised column and break the top crate before the stairs vanish.
puzzles.wrongOrder: Breaking the lowest materialised crates first in S7 removes the stairs; spending the slow-mo meter before hitting the switch.
puzzles.loss: All-box only: the materialised crates and the S7 top crate count, the route does not need them.

puzzles.summary: Bonus opener: 7 Nitro lie on a bridge directly above an iron row with a red ! in the middle.
puzzles.solution: Detonate the Nitro row from the start ledge in slow-mo and stay out of the chain; then hit the exposed red ! and collect its outlines.
puzzles.wrongOrder: Walking under the bridge to reach the ! first: any jump touches a Nitro.
puzzles.loss: Death (bonus restarts) or the bonus count; the Nitros themselves are 7 of the 33.

puzzles.summary: A column of three ? stands at the end of a 6-Nitro row.
puzzles.solution: Land on top of the column and stomp down through it, then chain-detonate the row from a distance.
puzzles.wrongOrder: Spinning the column from the side touches the Nitro beside it.

puzzles.summary: TNT with a crate stacked on top, on a narrow ledge under falling ice.
puzzles.solution: Jump and spin into the top crate: it breaks and the TNT starts its fuse; step back along the ledge.
puzzles.wrongOrder: Spinning the TNT at ground level, or standing on it for the top crate.
puzzles.loss: A life (the fuse or the falling ice), not crates: the blast still breaks the top crate.

puzzles.summary: Hidden-gem stack on a pier behind a collapsing platform.
puzzles.solution: Bounce off the top crate to reach the hidden gem first, then smash the stack.
puzzles.wrongOrder: Smashing the stack first removes the only springboard.
puzzles.loss: The hidden gem (crates are kept either way).

puzzles.summary: Exit crate sign plus Nitro switch.
puzzles.solution: Check the sign (151/153 here); press the green ! to credit the 2 Nitros you avoided.
puzzles.wrongOrder: Leaving through the exit without pressing the switch.

observations: Mask first: the slow-time mask is given at the spawn and the first three red-! groups (S1) are its tutorial on safe ground, before any enemy can punish a slow line.

Density curve: 17 / 18 / bonus 33 / 6 / 5 / 6 / 20 / 11 / 6 / 15 / 16. The bonus is 22 % of the level in about 40 s; the stretch after the bonus is deliberately thin while the set pieces (ship explosion, falling ice) play.

Seven count traps (35 crates) are off the forward line: tower after a cutscene (S4-a), floe crates that drift toward the camera (S6-a, S9-b), the gem pier (S6-b), two waterfall caches (S6-f, S10-a) and the crate above the timed stairs (S7-b).
Water crates are reached by riding a drifting floe, not by jumping: their placement teaches reading the current.

Explosive grammar escalates: TNT on a boat deck beside collectibles (S2-b), TNT under a crate (S8-a), TNT crowning a column next to an enemy (S10-b), TNT on swinging platforms (S10-d/e). The main route uses TNT only; Nitro appears in the bonus and as 2 hidden Nitros paid by the exit switch.
In the bonus, Nitro is used as a lid: a 7-Nitro bridge over the switch row (B-a) and a 6-Nitro row under a ? column (B-h). Nitros count when they explode, so clearing the lid is itself box credit.
Crates as tools: the gem stack is a springboard (S6-b), the arrow crate reaches a floating pair (S6-d/e), and the timed stairs are made of crates (S7-a).
Fruit-heavy rewards (gold fruit crate S7-c, flame pyramid S5-b) sit on detours that feed the 80 % fruit gem rather than the box gem.
Checkpoints close up late in the level (cumulative 17, 79, 105, 116, 122): the icefall and falling-ice ledges are the death-heavy part, and C4/C5 sit 11 and 6 crates apart.
The exit crate sign shows n/153 before the Nitro switch, so a player sees exactly what is missing before committing to the finish.
